segments.text: Vidyashiri Resatta Mantra Rehasyam, the secret essence of Mantra, Mantra Rehasyam, the
secret essence of Mantra is establishment in the body of knowledge of Oneness, Vidyashiri
Resatta.
Knowledge is here, Mantra daiprata, Supreme knowledge of Oneness, monastic thought, serve
Vidyashiri, Bhagavan, Shabda Rashi, that is in real sense, Supreme God, who is the formation
of collection of all sounds.
All sounds are stored there.
All sounds are created from that point.
Asyaishi, we should obey the main Purna-Ham, Mumarashana-atma, Mumarashana-atma, Svara-ta.
So in other sense, this state of God consciousness is that God consciousness, which is one with
universe, we should obey the main, and one with universe and filled with Supreme
eye-ic consciousness.
This is the essence of all mantras.
Not Omnumashwai, Omnumabhagalli-tevas-devas, these mantras are not mantras in real sense.
Mantra is that Supreme eye consciousness.
This is Upanishad, this is secret.
This is also quoted in Ritendra-sadbha-vatantra, Sarve-varna-atma-kha-mantra, Teji-Shaktya-atma-kha-priya,
Shaktis-pumatrika-gaya-sajya-gaya-shiva-atma-kha.
All letters are actually one with mantra.
And those mantras are one with energy of Lord Shiva, mother, and that mother is one with Lord
Shiva itself.
Tatrava-jaya-amartha-aithar-hasop-vita-dya-suf-ti-kruta.
In that tantrasadbha-shastra, this exposition is put forth.
Although this exposition is beyond the explanation.
You cannot explain this, you cannot expose this secret, but it is exposed there in tantrasadbha.
In this way, Najanand-Gurum-devam, Shastra-khtan, Samyanstha, Dambakautil, Nirata, Lawliyartha,
Kriyo-jita, Asma-tukarana, Devi, Maya, Viryam, Pragopitam, Tena-guf-tena-te-guf-ta, Shesha-varna-astu-kevalam.
This is the saying of Lord Shiva to Parvati.
So Parvati, those people who do not believe that our master is one with Lord Shiva.
And who are away from maintaining the discipline as explained in Shastras, discipline.
You have already heard that discipline.
And those who are Dambakautil in Nirata, who are Kruket, Lawliyartha, attached to worldly
pleasures, Kriyo-jita, without any sadhana, without doing any effort.
It is because of these things, they are mantras, I have extracted the splendor from their mantras.
So when that splendor is taken away from those mantras, those mantras are useless for them.
Those mantras are as good as letters for them with no value.
So you must take it for granted that master is one with Lord Shiva.
And you must maintain discipline there, character there.
You must not be given to worldly attachments towards worldly pleasures.
When you are doing this, when you have done this, then your mantra will remain successful
and the splendor will be there.
Yati piti ka pandam krita, beginning from this.
And then Tantrasadbhava has explained Yasa to Madrika Devi Paradeja Samannita, that Supreme Divine Mother,
who is filled with Supreme Prakashya, Supreme Light, Taya Vyavtham Yudam Vishamsa Brahma Bhuvanaantakam.
That Divine Mother has pervaded all the world, the whole universe up to Brahma-Logra.
Tattrastham ji Yadav Devi, Vyavtham chasuraar chite, Avarna sthu, Yata Avarna sthita sarvagata priya.
O Devi, just as all letters are found in first letter, letter O or A, first letter.
First letter holds all the collection of letters.
In the same way, the whole universe is found in that Supreme Devi, divine Mother.
Regarding this divine Mother, I will explain to you some important points.
Yasa, Shakti, Paras, Sukhsma, Nira, Chhare, Dikir, Tata, Trivindum, Veshti, Tanta, Sushvth, Bhujaga, Krati.
That divine Mother is Supreme, is Sukhsma, subtle, Nira, Chhara, without any religion.
There is no religion, because that Supreme Mother, Kundlini, but others, thoughts of school,
call it serpent power, it is not serpent power, it is Nira, Chhara, without any religion.
Even in a Mohamedan's body, it can rise, in cat also, it can rise, if there is some force
put by Lord Shiva in that cat.
So it is Nira, Chhara, it has no religion, Fredbindum, Veshti, Tanta, Sushvth, Bhujaga, Krati.
That divine Mother is placed in the Bindu, Bindu of heart.
Heart is not here, heart is everywhere in body, heart is the center of awareness, there you
will find that divine Mother, Sushvth, Bhujaga, Krati.
She is just like the serpent, in sleeping state, Tattrasufta Mahabhade, Nakhinecheth Manyati
Ume, O Parvati, there she takes rest, and that place is called by our masters Mooladara,
near rectum, there she is placed and asleep, Nakhinecheth Manyati Ume.
So there is no perception of any kind other than her own self.
She does not perceive anything other than her own self, that divine Mother.
And in addition, that goddess after placing inner body, Chandra, Moon, Agni, Fire, Ravi,
Sun, Nakhshetay, All Stars, and all the 14 worlds are placed in her own body.
And she is absolutely unaware of all this happening in her own nature.
But how to awaken it?
Now he explains that Prabuddha, Sahninadena, Parena, Janarupena, Matheta, Chodarashtena,
Vindana, Varvarani, now Sadaka has to do, you can't awaken her with push, it can be awakened
only by Nada, Paramarsha, Supreme Eye Consciousness.
And that Eye Consciousness must be filled with Supreme awareness, Parena, Janarupena, Matheta,
Chodarashtena, Vindana, Varvarani.
And in heart, you have to turn your point, point of one point in us.
One point of one point in us is to be churned again and again, again and again, without any
break.
When you churn it, churning means when you put awareness, when you put sparks of awareness
in it, one after another, one after another, don't put only one spark in that awareness.
If you put only one spark, that spark will get faded and there will be no awareness in
course of time.
So let it fade, let one spark fade, put awareness afresh again.
Let that fade, put again fresh awareness.
In the same way, you have to put that fresh awareness in continuity.
And then what happens to Avatvaya Brahmavaya again, Matanam Shakthi Vigraya, the body of energy
which is situated, which is established in the body of divine mother Kundalini.
That body of energy is also churned by this awareness.
Bheda to Pratamavat Panna, Vindavas, Deitya Varchasa, first you will feel that everywhere,
light side, left side, front, back side, up, down, everywhere, you will feel light is going
on.
Bhinda Vah means light, all lights, atta Varchasa, filled with fresh, I mean very dense lights.
And by those lights, Uchita, Uyeda, Tena, Kala, Sukshma, Kundalini, that Kundalini gets
rise by that light and that non, Chotush Kalamayo, Bindu, Shakthir, Uddhara, Gapravo.
In the body of that Kundalini, there Sadaka finds Bindu, Bindu means it is a kind of, how
can I explain it to you?
It is a kind of, spring, semen, spring, that virya, that gets agitated there, because the
Kundalini, the formation of Kundalini is of that semen, is of that spring, semen, it is not,
it is not that individual semen, it is something beyond and it is experienced only by yogis.
Just imagine how joyous his formation would be by this, because she is formed with this,
the formation of that body is of that spring, semen, that is Bindu.
And that Bindu is Chotush Kalamayo, it has got four projections, this Bindu which is residing
in the body of Kundalini, has four projecting, projecting lines, projecting centers.
One center is, one first projecting center is that of subjective consciousness, subjective
awareness.
One is subjective awareness, the second is cognitive awareness, third is objective awareness,
fourth is digestive awareness.
You know digestive awareness, subjective awareness is of that of Pramatri, Pramatri means
when or subjuice, who is, who is knower, awareness of knower, awareness of the state of knower,
awareness of the state of knowledge is cognitive awareness, and awareness of the state
of knower, that is objective awareness.
These three kinds of awareness arise from that center of that Kundalini Bhagavad-gita.
And the fourth projection is digestive projection, digestive projection is that projection, where
subjective, cognitive and objective projections are digested, they are not separated, they
are not differentiated, they are not known differentiatedly.
All these projects are one there, without any distinction, there is no difference, differentiation
between one and another, another, in that state of digestive project, that is digestive project
in Sanskrit, it is called Pramati Bhag, Pramana Bhag, Pramei Bhag and Pramati Bhag.
Pramati is digestive state of thought, and all these four projects are centered in the body
of Kundalini, this four-fold centers are residing in the body of Kundalini.
Now what is to be done?
You have to do matmanthani yogi, that which is to be churned and churned, churned and churned,
churned is doing like this, churned is that curds or milk or anything, what is to be churned,
and these both happen simultaneously, churner is there, and that churned is there,
Rizutam jayate pray, when you put that churner in that body of Kundalini, Rizutam jayate pray,
it rises in a straight line, what rises in a straight line, Kundalini, Kundalini that
divine mother, and that divine mother is nominated there, at that point, jayata shakti, jayata
shakti, sumrata asatu, bindu dhai, sumat dega, because it is absolutely established between
these two bindus, one of Pramati Bhag and the other of Pramei Bhag, one subjective and
other objective, between subjective and objective, centers the rise of jayata shakti takes place
in the form of Kundalini, binduna, chobam ayata, rekhai, maratukundalini, then when these
two bindus, subjective awareness and cognitive awareness are also agitated by the process
of churning, more and more, rekhai, maratukundalini, then that Kundalini gives rise to real pure
supreme siman, that siman rises in the form of Kundalini, from bottom to top, rekhini nam
asagaya, uva bindu yadantagav, there she is nominated as rekhini Bhagavati, that Kundalini
is called as rekhini, and there you won't find subjective, project or objective project
anywhere, because subjective project and objective project, these both projects are diluted
in there, in oneness of that supreme bliss of that rise of siman, supreme siman, it is super
siman, trepathasa, samakshata, raudri, namna, to giyata, when that rises, what happens next?
Diyogi comes out at once, because there is no tolerance of that joy of nectar, what he
experiences there, he cannot tolerate that, so he comes out, it is, it is, it is but a natural,
just he reaches that state, he comes out, it is the, it is the way it happens to everybody,
so there she is called trepatha, she takes formation of all the three centers, again all the three
centers rise, subjective center, objective center and cognitive center, then these all three
centers rise, again from Kundalini, their Kundalini is nominated as raudri, this energy of Kundalini
is called raudri, because this energy is that energy which puts obstacle in the journey of,
in the journey of that final liberation, so what we have to do there, we have to go again and again
inside, don't think that you have lost anything, go and maintain awareness of that oneness and
go inside again and again, don't fear, wait for master's direction, go, go inside again and again,
leave it there, because it is moksha marka nirodhana, the way of moksha is stopped, then what happens,
tashanga shakala kara amika chard chandrika, then again she takes the formation of half moon shape,
shesanga shakala kara, half moon shape is half inside and half outside, this is the state,
real state of kramamundra, that takes place afterwards, and blessed yogis experience this state,
in the end. So, ekai vetam parashakti stridhasa to prajayati, if that supreme divine mother is only one,
she takes these three formations, one for inferior yogi, one for bogey, and third for
superior, abyo yuktu viyukta abya sanjatu navarga ka, navada chusumratasa to navarga palakshata,
by these energies of mother, divine mother of Kundini, nine classes of letters have risen,
now work, one is a work, the next is covered, the third is chavark, fourth is tavark, fifth is
tavark, pavark, bhavark, chavark, all these classes of letters,
take rise from that mother, divine Kundini,
pancha mandragata, adi vi sadya, adi ar anukrama, there are five sacred states of self that rise from
this Kundini, isyan tattpur sadhujat, vamdev and over, these five, five mouths of Lord Shiva have
appeared from this Kundini, so Lord Shiva can speak to public, Lord Shiva can help, Lord Shiva can
preach, explain everything, because of these five mouths, but those five mouths take rise from Kundini,
so Lord Shiva is dependent to Kundini, Saurad-Dohada-Shigadevi, Dohada-Shastra, Udayarata, 12
warriors also rise from this divine mother, Kundini, and fifty letters also rise from the same mother,
and now take three, three speeches, supreme, medium and inferior, Ritstha-Ekanava-Prokta,
in heart it is said to be centered in that supreme, supreme sound, supreme speech, that is
pasanti, pasanti rise in heart, in throat, madhama rises, kante prokta-dityaka,
with one arrow, with anu, anu means point, ek anava, kante prokta-dityaka, in throat it is,
so heart is the center of pasanti speech, throat is the center of madhama speech,
and tongue is the center of vayakri speech, you see, heart, when there is something,
something to be told, first it is to be taken from heart, once heart, you have to take it out from heart,
for instance you have to speak to some person, where had you been? This is in my mind,
to tell him where had you been, and before that what happened in my mind? It was in my mind only,
it was in my throat that I will tell him where had you been, before that it was in heart,
and there was no different differentiation of letters there, words there, there was nothing
only consciousness, something force that was to take place in the next moment, next future,
so in heart it is ek anava with one atom, that is pasanti, it is called pasanti work,
in the next work it is called madhama work, it is in throat, and the third work is vayakri,
it is in tongue, many speak words, so all these sounds appear in tongue,
evam shabda shinish pati shabdaya aftam charasm, so this whole universe resides on sound,
this is the process of sound, and that sound is carried from that soundless center of Kundalini.
So, spring, spring energy of spring speech is the source of all these speeches.
It is why all these letters rise from that spring,
center of that energy of God consciousness, that is divine mother.
Varna sangatana, shri rana, mantranam, saibhagvati, vayakhatrupa, vidayashiri, etc.,
and all mantras which I recited by sadhakas, those mantras also get weary, and splinter from that
spring, the day of God consciousness, Kundalini. Pratyagamamja, matrika, malini, prasthara, puro,
kambantru, dharikatane, say, I am eva asya, it is why that matrika and malini, matrika is
the system of letters from ear to shore, from a to z, but there is another way of system of letters,
it is not in order, it is orderless world of letters, that is called malini in our system,
in our Kashmir shayam. And these two ways of these letters get rise from this Kundalini.
Because Shiv Sutras are actually the most sacred and essential thoughts of Lord Shiva.
So, we have given references of so many tantras in this. So, you should not get worried for our
giving so many references here. Idina asma biyam asu yitaviyama, eva may pi samadite agame if
already we have given so many references, to make you understand what is in real sense Kundalini.
If you don't understand even then, tasma sushadguru supariya kaya,
if you take hold of the feet of your master then, asya sutra artha tada krem yubalam mandra, this
artha of sutra is narrated in spanda in this chaloga, tada krem yubalam mandra. All mantras get
life because of this Kundalini, center of all mantras, center of all mantras is Kundalini.
Navarhad yangami bhavdi. Ape tu anushangik matr bindo nada adi kala janit asu mith siddhishu
chitam rohati desha. Although this mantra virya, eva may vidam etat mandra virya, this mantra virya
is brought out in existence by meditating on supreme heart of eye consciousness. This is a fact.
If you meditate on supreme heart of eye consciousness, this mantra virya comes in its real existence.
But when by the opposite will of Lord Shiva, that is the will of Tyrodhana, not Anugraha,
some unfortunate men, parme siri chhatyeva nada radyangami bhavdi, do not realize this eye consciousness
and on the contrary Ape tu and on the contrary Anushangik matr bindo nada adi kala janit asu mith siddhishu
chitam rohati desha satisfy their minds in limited yogic powers and they are satisfied with those limited
powers. For instance, flying in the sky, giving some boons to disciples and so on. For them,
this next sutra explains how they happen to be in in next future.
